subject: Conditional panel based on a checkbox element

messages.author: 605c14114b1f1179
messages.subject: Conditional panel based on a checkbox element
parts:
Hello

Does anyone know how to write the condition (in javascript) for a conditional panel that will display a widget, if a specific element in the checkboxGroupInput is selected?
Ie: the javascript equivalent for the following R expression:

"e" %in% input$checkboxGroupInput_widget
where e is an element of the choices available for the checkboxGroupInput

Thanks in advance

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: Conditional panel based on a checkbox element
parts:
You can use `$.inArray()`, for example

library(shiny)
runApp(shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(
    checkboxGroupInput("test", "Test", letters[1:10]),
    conditionalPanel("$.inArray('e', input.test) > -1", "e is selected")
  ),
  server = function(input, output) {
  }
))
